Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter to rows where efo_id and efo_term are not null. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical_smiles. Return distinct rows for chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
